user.title: Connect an EteSync account
user.description: Every task list of the account becomes a to-do list. Add the integration again to connect more accounts.

data_description.url: Keep the default for the hosted EteSync service. For a self-hosted Etebase server, enter its base URL (without /api/v1/).
data_description.password: Your EteSync password. It is only used to log in and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate EteSync
reauth_confirm.description: The session of {username} on {url} is no longer valid. Enter the password to log in again.

error.account_not_initialized: This account has never been used. Log in once with an official EteSync app to set it up.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server.
error.not_etebase_server: No Etebase server was found at this URL.

abort.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different account.

auth_failed.message: The EteSync session expired and could not be renewed. Re-authenticate the account.

conflict.message: The task was changed by another device. Try again.

invalid_session.message: The stored EteSync session could not be read. Re-authenticate the account.

list_not_found.message: The task list does not exist (anymore).

read_only.message: The task list {list} is shared read-only with this account.
